title: Dismissible announcement bar
when: The user wants a thin bar above the header with a short site wide message, such as a sale, shipping notice or new feature.
inputs: start and end dates if any
prompt:
Goal: A one line message bar that links somewhere useful, stays dismissed once closed and never shifts layout on load.
Steps:
1. <aside aria-label="Announcement"> above the header: one sentence of at most 90 characters, one link, <button type="button" aria-label="Close announcement">.
2. Each message has an id such as promo-2026-11; on close save it in localStorage inside try and catch, so a new message shows again.
3. No flash: a tiny inline head script reads the saved id and sets a class on <html> that hides the bar before paint.
4. Optional end date: compare Date.now() with data-ends and hide the bar after it.
5. On phones allow two lines; never use scrolling marquee text.
Quality bar:
- Benefit and deadline in plain words.
- The bar scrolls away with the page.
- Text and link at 4.5 to 1 on the bar color.
Pitfalls:
- Storage errors in private mode that break the page script.
- A bar that returns on every page after closing.
- Link text such as Click here.
Verify:
- [ ] The bar has a name and a labeled close button.
- [ ] Dismissal persists after reload.
- [ ] Storage access is in try and catch.
- [ ] No layout shift on load.
Output: Bar markup before the header, its CSS, the inline head script and bar.js.

examples.input: barra no topo avisando frete gratis ate domingo
examples.output: aside Announcement "Free shipping until Sunday", link to the offer, close saved as promo-free-shipping
